June 24, 2004: CrossFit.com programs Grace for the first time. 30 clean and jerks for time, 135/95 lb. No pull-up bar, no running, just you and the barbell. Most people land between 4 and 7 minutes. The fastest go under 2:00, that's a rep every 4 seconds.
